title: 806 Caprock Canyon TRL, Georgetown, TX 78633
description: Joanna Pearce Realtor with Thompson & Bounds presents: A beautiful 2 bedrooms 2 bath approximate 1603 square feet Jimmy Jacobs custom home located in Heritage Oaks 55 and older community. This home offers custom cabinets through-out the home. Granite countertops in the kitchen with a breakfast area surrounded by large windows. The formal dining room is open to the stunning living room which offers a custom built-in entertainment center. The home has an enclosed patio with lighting and a fan, the backyard is open to the walking/hiking trails exclusively available to the residents.
